title: Neuromotor Interaction Graphs: code for 'Inferring Functional Motor Control Networks from Handwriting Dynamics for Explainable Parkinson's Disease Assessment'
description: Analysis code for the article (Information Sciences, manuscript INS-D-26-7505): within-subject Transfer Entropy graphs of handwriting kinematics, the seven Neuromotor Graph Signature descriptors, nested validation, the leakage audit of the first submission, estimator bias and reliability analyses, native-resolution and multi-task designs, GCN comparison and cross-dataset transfer. Datasets are not included.
